newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTOR RACING-BERGER IN F1 CAR FOR FIRST TIME SINCE MAY.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BERGER IN F1 CAR FOR FIRST TIME SINCE MAY.

text.p: Austria's Gerhard Berger will this week drive his Benetton for the first time since undergoing a sinus operation in May, a spokesman for the Formula One driver said on Tuesday.
Berger flew to Milan on Tuesday and will test the car in Monza on Wednesday and Thursday.
On Monday Berger attended the funeral of his father Johann, who was killed when his private plane crashed last week.
Berger missed the last three grands prix in Montreal, Magny Cours and Silverstone and was replaced in the Benetton cockpit by compatriot Alexander Wurz.
